    Code blocks

    Good documentation empowers engineers to spend more time coding, and less time searching around for the code snippets they need. In Notion, it's easy to add code blocks to any document - there's even built in syntax coloring for 60+ programming languages!

    • Documentation
    • Engineering
    3 min video

    Uh-oh! It looks like your ad blocker is preventing the video from playing.

    Please watch it on YouTube

    • With Notion, you can include code blocks in documents, saving time on searching for scripts and commands.

      • Engineers can easily add code snippets to Notion pages, like meeting notes and docs—with automatic syntax highlighting for over 60 programming languages.

      • Code blocks can be adjusted for better visibility, with options to wrap code or copy to clipboard.

    • This Notion feature leads to better documentation, and helps engineers produce more efficient work.
